source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
[Diseased Influence](vsdata:ability/death-guard.mortarion.diseased-influence) on Mortarion is rewritten. Right after an enemy unit's **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** ends 8" or less from a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours, that **DEATH GUARD** unit may make a Normal move, up to 5", if it is:

- no more than 6" from Mortarion
- outside **Engagement Range** of all enemy units
